text: Does a cable company live on its subscriptions?
From July to September, Den Networks booked eighty six crore rupees of subscription income.
Its bill for channels was one hundred and sixty two crore. Almost double.
So what covers the rest? Fees from broadcasters: one hundred and forty one crore.
G T P L Hathway shows the same three piles. Its booked subscription is forty four percent of its channel bill.
One caution. These are figures the companies book. The filings do not say what a home pays, or what the local operator keeps.
So why is the channel bill bigger? The filings do not say. Which brings us back to the question.
